prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently degraded performance across 2 tests and led to early stops.
Home wait-time info (4 wins across 8 tests), adoption redesigns (2 wins across 5 tests), and finish redesigns (2 wins across 7 tests) yielded clear wins, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Choose-path layout (4 tests), choose-path copy (3 tests), sign-in hints (4 tests), sign-in notifications (4 tests), and sign-in copy (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance.
Categories with only a single test (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or finish notifications) still provide evidence that is thin.
Predictions consistently underestimated major winning tests while overestimating changes that showed no clear effect or degraded performance.

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] waiting_pet_controls_preview_flow: Adds an interactive flow on the waiting screen showing users how to hide, summon, and talk to their pet while background rendering completes. (why: Addresses user support tickets about confusion over controlling/hiding pets after onboarding and leverages the home waiting screen where engagement wins were achieved previously.)
1: [finish, redesign] home_intro_desktop_visibility_guide_redesign: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a focused visual guide demonstrating desktop tray toggles and pet summoning shortcuts. (why: Support logs show multiple complaints about pets missing from desktop or users being unable to locate controls post-setup.)
2: [finish, hint] home_intro_pet_toggle_shortcut_hint: Adds a clear hint banner explaining system tray pet toggling and summon shortcuts on the home intro screen. (why: Support tickets highlight post-onboarding confusion around pet controls and desktop visibility.)
3: [home, notification] waiting_screen_render_alert_notification: Enables a system readiness notification toggle on the wait screen to notify users when rendering finishes. (why: High mean wait times (2336s) cause users to drop or minimize the window; notifications pull them back into the app.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] pick_friend_customization_preview_flow: Introduces a trait customization preview flow on the companion selection screen before moving to adoption. (why: Adoption step redesigns have shown strong conversion potential, and customization previews improve pet creation satisfaction.)
5: [adoption, copy] upload_photos_clarity_check_copy: Updates copy on photo upload to explicitly instruct users on bright lighting and clear front-facing angles. (why: Directly tackles support complaints about custom pet creation failing or generating distorted pet models.)
